about_the_game:
🔧 IMPORTANT – WORK IN PROGRESS DEMO 🔧
This demo is a work in progress developed by a solo developer over the last 2 years. Many features are still in development, and you may encounter bugs or unfinished content.
Any feedback or suggestions are truly appreciated.
I genuinely hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoy making it—this project is made with all my heart!

⚽ Soccer meets air hockey with an incredible twist: fast-paced, zany robots inspired by your favorite pop culture icons.

This isn’t just about speed and strength; strategy, quick moves, and clever plays are the keys to victory. This game guarantees endless fun and high-octane action. Step into the arena and show them who’s the champion!

KEY FEATURES:

  • Up to 8 players in online matches

  • Competitive matchmaking, friendly lobbies, and local couch mode

  • Country and global rankings across multiple categories

  • Up to 4 players in split-screen couch mode

  • Combine up to 4 local players with online lobbies (up to 4v4)

  • Small robots resembling a cross between air hockey pucks and mini soccer players

  • Customizable characters with tons of accessories

  • Collect all your Roomballs, buy new models and accessories to customize them even more

  • Earn Roombolts and other valuable items by winning matches and completing missions

  • Variety of arenas with unique vibes

  • Matchmaking system designed to find your perfect rivals

  • Progression system based on your in-game performance

Roomballs isn’t just about competition—it’s about community.
Share your achievements, build friendships, have fun, and compete to become the ultimate Roomball champion!
